crossRefs.note: Now go, lead the people to the place of which I have spoken to you. Behold, my angel shall go before you. Nevertheless…
I will be his father, and he will be my son. If he commits iniquity, I will chasten him with the rod of men, and with…
Solomon did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and didn’t go fully after Yahweh, as David his father did.
Yahweh raised up an adversary to Solomon: Hadad the Edomite. He was one of the king’s offspring in Edom.
He said to Jeroboam, “Take ten pieces; for Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘Behold, I will tear the kingdom out of the…
I will afflict the offspring of David for this, but not forever.’ ”
My son, don’t despise Yahweh’s discipline, neither be weary of his correction;
for whom Yahweh loves, he corrects, even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.
“I have only chosen you of all the families of the earth. Therefore I will punish you for all of your sins.”
For if we discerned ourselves, we wouldn’t be judged.
But when we are judged, we are punished by the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.
for whom the Lord loves, he disciplines, and chastises every son whom he receives.”

translations.web: then I will punish their sin with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.
translations.bsb: I will attend to their transgression with the rod, and to their iniquity with stripes.
translations.kjv: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.
translations.asv: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, And their iniquity with stripes.
